coverage_notes: Exhaustive survey covering six DB-bundled/embedded graph explorers: Neo4j Bloom, Memgraph Lab, Kuzu Explorer, gDotV, NebulaGraph Explorer, and SemSpect. For each product, sourced: official homepages, product documentation, pricing pages, release notes, competitive comparisons, and third-party evidence (G2/Capterra reviews, Gartner mentions, DB-Engines rankings, academic papers). Additional sources capture HCI research on graph visualization challenges, market analysis from 2025-2026, and cross-product competitive positioning. Deduplication by URL. Sources assigned T0-T3 tiers per rubric (primary capture, official docs, analyst reports, practitioner essays) with license_note indicating redistribute-ok (academic PDFs, open-source repos) vs reference-only (SaaS product pages, proprietary analyst reports). Coverage spans visualization paradigms (2D/3D, no-code querying, aggregation for hairball problem), deployment models (embedded vs. cloud vs. plugin), and HCI pain points addressed by each tool. Total 50+ sources covering functionality, pricing, user evidence, and competitive landscape.
